Geology Department, AWKUM offers a versatile & challenging future to young students interested in the exploration and exploitation of natural resources. Undergraduate geologists have an opportunity to work in diverse fields such as:
• Exploration (Oil & Gas) , Hydrogeology, Geophysics
• Geochemistry, Gemology
• Engineering Geology
• Mining Geology & Environmental Geology.
• Structure Geology and Mapping
• Petroleum Geoscience
• Sedimentology
• Minerology
• Industrial Minerology
